;Disasters and accidents
*A plant explosion in the [[Jiangsu]] province of [[China]] kills seven and injures five others. The explosion is the second deadliest in the month after the [[2019 Xiangshui chemical plant explosion]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast/seven-killed-in-china-plant-explosion-second-deadly-blast-this-month-idUSKCN1RC0AC (Reuters)]
*Severe thunderstorms in [[Nepal]] leave at least 25 people dead while more than 400 others are injured. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/officials-20-killed-hundreds-injured-rainstorm-southern-nepal-62073305 (ABC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/31/nepal-thunderstorm-severe-25-dead-hundreds-injured (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**[[Taiwan]] condemns [[China]] after two [[People's Liberation Army Air Force|PLAAF]] fighter jets pass the maritime line on the [[Taiwan Strait]]. Though there was no immediate response from China, the move comes after a week when the [[United States Navy]] and [[United States Coast Guard]] sent ships through the Strait. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-china/taiwan-condemns-china-after-chinese-jets-flew-past-a-maritime-line-idUSKCN1RC0ID (Reuters)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/taiwan-condemns-china-after-chinese-jets-flew-past-a-maritime-line-11397794 (Channel NewsAsia)] [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/03/31/asia-pacific/taipei-blasts-provocative-flight-chinese-fighters-taiwan-strait/#.XKDRt5hKhPY (''The Japan Times'')]
*[[United States recognition of the Golan Heights as part of Israel]]
**During the 30th [[Arab League]] summit held in [[Tunisia]], leaders condemn the [[United States]]' claim that the [[Golan Heights]] belong to [[Israel]], and stated the establishment of a [[Palestinian state]] is essential for stability. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-arabs-summit/arab-leaders-grappling-regional-rifts-condemn-u-s-decision-on-golan-idUSKCN1RC060 (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/arab-leaders-call-palestinian-state-condemn-golan-move-190331122623860.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/arab-leaders-meet-in-tunisia-with-eye-on-trumps-golan-move/2019/03/31/c3b66466-5390-11e9-aa83-504f086bf5d6_story.html?utm_term=.25ca29cf269c (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*Fourteen suspected communist rebels are killed in the [[Philippines]]. However, human rights groups dispute the claims by police forces stating those killed were farmers. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/news/asean/1654224/philippine-police-kill-14-men-rights-groups-say-were-farmers (''The Bangkok Post'')] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/14-farmers-killed-in-philippine-police-massacre-activists-11397608 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*Three teenage migrants who partook in the hijacking of ''[[Elhiblu 1]]'' are charged in [[Malta]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/31/world/europe/migrants-hijacking-ship-malta.html (''The New York Times'')]
*American rapper [[Nipsey Hussle]] is shot and killed outside a [[Los Angeles]] clothing store. Two other people with him were also shot and wounded. [https://globalnews.ca/news/5116559/rapper-nipsey-hussle-shot-dead/ (Global News) ]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Ukrainian presidential election]]
**Voters in Ukraine go to the polls today in the first round of the presidential election. [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Petro Poroshenko]] is seeking re-election, with  comedian [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] and former [[Prime Minister of Ukraine|Prime Minister]] [[Yulia Tymoshenko]] the primary challengers. All three have expressed largely pro-European views. Former Vice Prime Minister [[Yuriy Boyko]] is the front-runner among the pro-Russian candidates. A total of 39 candidates are on the ballot, increasing the probability no candidate will win more than 50 percent of the votes. If so, the top two will meet in a second round on 21 April. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47763176 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Slovak presidential election]]
**Anti-corruption candidate [[Zuzana Čaputová]] of the  [[Progressive Slovakia]] party wins the second round of Slovakia's presidential election, defeating  the governing party candidate [[Maroš Šefčovič]], 58 percent versus 42%. She will be the country's first female head of state. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47756368 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Turkish local elections]]
**Voters head to the polls in [[Turkey]] to vote on metropolitan and district municipal mayors along with provincial and municipal councillors. The election is believed to be contested on challenging the current [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47764393 (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/economy-security-spotlight-turks-set-local-polls-190330150248508.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Sports
*[[Elvis Luciano]] of the [[Toronto Blue Jays]] becomes the first person born in the 2000s to play in a [[Major League Baseball]] game. [https://www.mlb.com/news/elvis-luciano-first-mlb-player-born-in-2000s (MLB.com)]
